description:
Maintainer request, 2026-08-13 07:4x. Assigned to the agent already holding the htgr_sim_v1 app files this session.

Requirement: the simulator must advance simulated time at wall-clock rate -- 1 s of plant time per 1 s of real time -- rather than free-running as fast as the physics steps, or drifting from wall clock.

Design constraints handed to the agent:
- Decouple physics dt from egui frame rate. Fixed-dt accumulator: accumulate wall-clock elapsed, step a whole number of fixed dt steps, keep the remainder. Do NOT scale physics dt to frame time -- a variable dt changes the integration and this plant has stiff couplings.
- Clamp the catch-up so a backgrounded/stalled app cannot attempt thousands of steps in one frame. When the clamp binds, simulated time falls behind real time VISIBLY rather than silently.
- Pacing is a scheduling concern; plant physics must not be changed to accommodate it.

PRIOR ART that must be read first (this ground has been covered before):
- op-fngw (P2 bug) -- 'the GUI stepped the plant at a rate no test drove, and it crashed'. Directly on point: whatever rate the GUI ends up driving must be a rate something tests.
- op-szmi.16 (P2 bug) -- 'still feels laggy AFTER the texture bake -- and it cannot measure itself'. If there is no achieved-vs-real-time instrumentation, adding it is part of this fix, not scope creep.
- op-szmi.5 -- the intended CIET v2 GUI standard.
- crates/tuas_boussinesq_solver/examples/ciet_educational_simulator/ -- check whether it already solves this and reuse if so (search-before-building rule).

This bead may well be a duplicate of, or the resolution path for, op-fngw and op-szmi.16 -- reconcile the three once the agent reports, rather than closing any of them now.

notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
DUPLICATE — do not work this bead. Filed by me 2026-08-13 without first searching the existing 909-issue store. The real issue is op-v5zb (P1), which predates it (2026-08-12) and is substantially better: it already identifies the root cause as thread::sleep(PHYSICS_TICK) called unconditionally AFTER the compute in examples/htgr_sim_v1/app/mod.rs, giving ratio = 10/(10+compute_ms), and prescribes deadline pacing. It also depends on op-775s (measure per-tick compute cost first), which this bead missed entirely.

Recommend the maintainer CLOSE this as a duplicate of op-v5zb. Leaving it open and annotated rather than closing it unilaterally.

The agent working htgr_sim_v1 has been redirected to op-v5zb.

title: htgr_sim_v1: pace the simulator to real time (fixed-dt accumulator, clamped catch-up)

description:
Found while doing op-dt3.26. A genuine asymmetry between two sibling validity checks that should behave the same.

REPRODUCTION (release mode, crate v0.2.5, 2026-08-11):
  let p = sat_pressure_4(ThermodynamicTemperature::new::<kelvin>(273.15));
  let s = SpecificHeatCapacity::new::<kilojoule_per_kilogram_kelvin>(4.0);
  t_ps_eqm(p, s)
  -> panics: 'entropy: two-phase (T,p) state (IAPWS-IF97 Region 4) is under-determined
     without steam quality x'

One ULP above that pressure it succeeds. The equivalent (p,h) call at exactly the same
pressure succeeds.

ROOT CAUSE. ps_flash_eqm/validity_range.rs::is_below_isotherm_t_273_15 computes its
lower entropy bound as

    s_tp_eqm_single_phase(ThermodynamicTemperature::new::<kelvin>(273.15), p)

At p == p_sat(273.15 K) bit-for-bit, region_fwd_eqn_single_phase matches its
'pres == p_sat_reg4_pascal' arm and returns Region4, whose (T,p) arm in
s_tp_eqm_single_phase is a deliberate panic (a single-phase (T,p) flash cannot resolve
a two-phase state).

The (p,h) sibling already dodges this. ph_flash_eqm/validity_range.rs:45-58 carries an
explicit NOTE explaining that the whole 273.15 K isotherm lies in Region 1 for every
valid pressure, and evaluates the bound with the Region-1 forward equation h_tp_1
directly instead of routing through h_tp_eqm_single_phase.

SUGGESTED FIX: make the (p,s) check symmetric - use s_tp_1(lower_temp_bound, p) instead
of s_tp_eqm_single_phase, and carry the same explanatory NOTE. s_tp_1 is the correct
saturated-liquid entropy on the saturation line and the correct compressed-liquid
entropy above it, exactly as h_tp_1 is for enthalpy.

CURRENT WORKAROUND, and what to do when this is fixed. interfaces::checked::ps
::check_ps_envelope encodes an EXCLUSIVE pressure floor (p > p_sat(273.15 K)) where
check_ph_envelope's is inclusive, and documents why in its module doc and in the
'(p,s)' bullet of interfaces::checked's own module doc. When this bug is fixed, that
floor should be relaxed to inclusive and three places updated in the same change:
  1. checked/ps.rs - the gate and its 'p == p_sat(273.15 K) trap' section
  2. checked/mod.rs - the '- ps' bullet under 'Other families covered by this facade'
  3. checked/tests.rs::out_of_range_ps_returns_err_not_panic - the assertion that
     p_triple() is rejected, which should become an acceptance
Precedent for exactly this cleanup: op-cv1c, where fixing the router's half-open
100 MPa edge let the facade drop its matching carve-out.

Note this is a low-severity practical issue (the triple-point isobar is an unusual
operating point) but it is a real IF97 state that the library rejects, and the
inconsistency between the two sibling checks is a trap for the next reader.

notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content: Fixed and pushed 2026-08-11 in commit b37e79a3 on develop. is_below_isotherm_t_273_15 now evaluates its lower entropy bound with the Region-1 forward equation s_tp_1, mirroring the (p,h) sibling's use of h_tp_1; checked/ps.rs pressure floor relaxed from exclusive to inclusive to match. Regression test ps_flash_accepts_exact_triple_point_isobar records methodology and measured results: t_ps_eqm(611.2126774443449 Pa, 4.0 kJ/(kg K)) = 273.15000000000003 K, identical to one ULP above, 2.8e-14 K from T_sat. cargo test --release -p tampines-steam-tables --lib interfaces::checked -> 11 passed, 0 failed. Note two pre-existing assertions in checked_control_volume_constructors and out_of_range_ps_returns_err_not_panic had been written for the exclusive floor and now assert acceptance.

title: tampines-steam-tables: (p,s) validity check panics at exactly p = p_sat(273.15 K), unlike (p,h)
